summary: Frontend rollback architectural verification (UE → modules plats). Tested with admin.principal@nectforma-demo.com on /pedagogie?tab=formations + /notes flows. KEY RESULTS: (1) CreateFormationModal: matieres-info-card PRESENT with copy 'Matières / Après la création de la formation, ouvrez-la pour ajouter vos matières...', ue-info-card ABSENT. (2) FormationCard list: each card shows 'X matières' (no UE refs). (4) GradeSheetView: data-testid='matieres-nav' PRESENT, 'modules-sidebar' PRESENT, 'ue-grouped-nav' ABSENT. Sidebar header reads 'Matières' with 3 flat module tabs. (5) CreatePeriodModal: opens cleanly (period-type-select visible), no UE blocks pre-rendered. (6) Bulletin de notes tab: modal opens for student Bernard Lucas without runtime error; the bulletin renderer was loading at screenshot time. NO 'is not defined' / ReferenceError observed in any flow. NO ErrorBoundary fallback triggered. Console only emits the harmless X-Frame-Options meta-tag warning. Overall: rollback UI is functional and matches the spec.
